prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Sergio, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Sergio thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "My neighbor who works at the city council just confirmed they are strictly enforcing massive, immediate fines for bins left on the sidewalk. They’re patrolling constantly, so please be careful since we clearly don't need even more rules."
text: The city council has officially launched a ruthless crackdown and is issuing astronomical fines for any bins left out for even a second. They have squads patrolling every street around the clock, so get your bins inside immediately before they target your house next!
